headline: Warm Tuesday for Perth before rain and a cooler change
standfirst: Plenty of sunshine for most of the week, with the city climbing to about 26°C on Tuesday. Most of the weather models then bring rain from Wednesday, heaviest on Thursday, with the top easing to around 16°C.

method: Our own calibrated rain chances cover only the days the pipeline could issue (Saturday), from the forecast made at 9:54pm Friday (Perth time), and describe the Bureau of Meteorology gauge, not your backyard. Every other figure is raw guidance from five global weather models (ECMWF, ECMWF AI, German ICON, US GFS, Japanese JMA) via Open-Meteo, retrieved at 10:00pm Friday, taken at each suburb. Temperatures are the middle value across the models. Model agreement is not a probability. Rain is measured 9am to 9am, as the Bureau reports it; each day's rain line covers 9am that day to 9am the next. This is not an official forecast: for warnings, use the Bureau of Meteorology.
